propositions: _iter_pages terminates on a short page and advances by requested page_size instead of actual page length, causing issues beyond the first capped page to be silently dropped from the inbound snapshot
Jira Data Center silently truncates maxResults when it exceeds jira.search.views.default.max, making a short first page appear as the complete result set
The pagination defect causes 92% data loss (230 of 250 issues) in servers that cap pages below the requested size, leaving only the first truncated page in the inbound snapshot
_iter_pages must advance by len(page) and terminate only on an empty page to match the pattern already applied in get_parent_map fix (change 1105)

A server that ignores startAt and returns the same non-empty page indefinitely should raise SilentTruncationError rather than loop forever, requiring an offset-stall guard in addition to the existing same-token-twice cursor-stall guard
